## Contract review
Reviewed at 2026-10-26T15:52Z

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `46774c371359c01d3d1d9a190cd61056dd09bcbc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, AGENTS.md

Inputs: card #26143 body and its three comments (triage first grade 6417894401, claim 6419390894, os-dev-report 6420148592); PR #26210 object, file list and net diff against `main`; the check-runs on `46774c37`; the rules text on `origin/main` at `6b935529` (no commit between merge-base `7111e14a` and `origin/main` touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` or `AGENTS.md`, so the homes read on `origin/main` are the diff's own base text); the head tree by `git show 46774c37:PATH`. PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (type Bot), relay-written as the claim says. Diff = 4 files, +10 / -10, all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; `reviewFace` hits = those four paths.

### ① Derived judgments

Judged against the order on the card — the maintainer's verbatim lines 「主干 Test Core 超时红这种应该立刻立卡啊,skills 没有约定吗?」「所以 main红这一类卡应该是 devx 立卡并立刻处理吗」「按照目前的规则,等分诊太慢了」 and the option chosen on the decision card 「席位直接立卡派发,分诊后补」 — against the triage first grade (first touch follows as a recorded grade, not a gate), and against the rest of the skill on `origin/main`.

**Rules added — right against the order, except as noted under (b).**
- `landing-operations.md:80` 「见主干/队列全量红的席位先找锚卡,无则立 p0 锚卡(门类 ①),域随失败面」 — the seeing seat named as actor, anchor lookup first, p0, filing class ① (`filing-gate.md:9`: a defect with a named landing), domain of the failing surface. Right.
- `:81` 「认领并派止血,⛔ 不等分诊首触、不等维护者;首触事后补,可改域、⛔ 不改动作」 — the card's exact words 不等分诊首触、不等维护者 are there; after-the-fact first touch, domain may change and action never, matches the triage grade. Right as an order; not executable cross-lane, see (b).
- `:82` 「首道止血 = 回退引入红的提交(主干末绿与首红之间找),根因另立卡」 — revert-first stanch, root cause on its own card. Right.
- `:83` the compressed fix-forward and hand-merge line, see (a).
- `execution-duties.md:10` and `:40` — the main-red anchor as the candidate rule's second exception, dispatched past triage, sweep audits after; the same shape as the sub-issue clause, as the card orders. Right.
- `triage-duties.md:25` and `:71` — triage still owes the in-flight anchor its first touch as a recorded grade, and the blanket in-flight line names it. Matches the triage seat's own reading in 6417894401. Right.
- `SKILL.md:170–171` 例外一 → 两例外 — needed, or the new rule loses SKILL.md's stricter-rule tie-break to 「`domain:*` 只由分诊席产出」 and 「无分诊审计评论 ⛔ 不得认领」. Right, and the same reasoning was owed to line 34, see (b).

**(a) Every retired line has a home or is a true duplicate — no lost rule.** Each claimed home opened on `origin/main`:
- `landing-operations.md` old 61 (Tier S) → `SKILL.md:204` 「受管面两层:Tier S = `.claude/**` 全树,余皆 Tier H 等人批;S 经达档复核 PASS 后 ready → 入队」 and `contract-review.md:37` 「落地前检两条,过则 Tier S 入队、Tier H 等人批」 with the two checks at `:37` and `:40`; this file's `:59` already points at `contract-review.md`. Same rule, same force.
- old 62 (Tier H) → `SKILL.md:186–189` and `:197`, `lanes/skills.md:17` 「Tier H 受管 PR 恒 draft 等维护者的字」, `contract-review.md:37`, and, stronger than any of those, 红线 `SKILL.md:27` 「⛔ 受管面 PR 无授权批准时永不翻 ready、入队或挂 auto-merge;批准在案后席位落地」. A true duplicate of a 红线. Old lines 60 「受管面照两层」 and 63 「⛔ 两层不由席位批准」 (head 60 and 61) still bind: the tiering is mechanical (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N` on the same line 60) and the reader reaches this file from the 路径分叉 fork (`SKILL.md:181`), which defines both tiers. The point of use loses only an in-file restatement.
- old 82–83 → new 83 「p0 fix-forward 止血跳队,限机械、根因已核实;维护者可按 governed 例外人工直合一行修复」: p0, 止血, 机械, 根因已核实 all kept; 「仅限 main-red 修复」 is carried by position (the line sits inside the block labelled 「main-red 约定①」 at line 80, before 「约定②」 at 84). Enough: the actor of the hand-merge clause is the maintainer, so no seat can act on a wider reading, and old line 83 (「也可…」) already leaned on the same label for its scope. A weakening of wording, not a lost rule; no other home exists and AGENTS.md carries none.
- `triage-duties.md` old 78 → 红线 `SKILL.md:30` 「⛔ 无代裁通道:席位只分析与推荐,裁决恒出自人工」, `SKILL.md:36` (需裁事项落卡进决策箱), `SKILL.md:276` 「⛔ 无代裁无自裁无子代理」, this file's `:5` tail 「⛔ 无代裁通道」, `lanes/director.md:22` (置信门). The literal token `auto-adjudicated` is read by no script on `origin/main` (a repo grep finds only this line, two protocol.ts comments and a ui CHANGELOG entry). A true duplicate of a 红线.
- `execution-duties.md:10` clause 「预贴 `pm:queue` 视同无」 → `SKILL.md:171` 「预贴标签只是建议,队列与级别只由分诊落笔」; the surviving head of line 10 (no audit comment ⇒ not a candidate) already implies it.
- `execution-duties.md:40` clause 「带父卡域与优先级」 → 「各带域与级」, the sub-issue's inheritance at `:39` 「优先级继承」 and `SKILL.md:170` 「sub-issue 承父卡域」; the anchor's domain and level come from `landing-operations.md:80`.
- `triage-duties.md:70` clause 「敲门在先」 → the sequence of head `:72–74` (敲门一次 → 12 小时无答复 ⇒ 释放) is that rule; the enumeration after 「例外:」 stays closed.

**(b) The cross-lane claim — FAIL, with the exact wording gap.** The card's own incident is cross-lane: the skills seat saw a `Test Core` red, which is no skills-lane surface, so the cross-lane case is the common case. New `landing-operations.md:80–81` has the seeing seat file with 「域随失败面」 and then 「认领并派止血」. 红线 `SKILL.md:34` 「执行席只在本车道认领」 is untouched; `SKILL.md:41` ranks 红线 above 细则, `:43` says a 红线 ⛔ 不因更合理的理由被推翻, and `:44` sends two conflicting 细则 to the stricter one. A seat reading the text, which by the rules-only convention carries no ruling quotation and so no ruling rank, files the anchor and then stops at 红线 34: the discovery-to-action gap the maintainer ordered away moves from 「等分诊」 to waiting for the owning lane. The channel the dev rides does not license it as written: `SKILL.md:175` admits cross-domain work through three channels only, and the third, 接手无主阻塞项, is defined at `dispatch-runbook.md:176` as 「只做 `Blocked-by:` 点名的那一张」 — a freshly filed anchor is named by no `Blocked-by:` line, and a seat with nothing in flight (the ruling says any seat that sees the red) has no card to name it from; `execution-duties.md:45` (「阻塞项无主 ⇒ 被挡席认领做掉」) has the same trigger. `cross-repo-coordination.md:38` 「执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领」 and `:42` 「不跨车道认领」 restate the 红线. The corpus's own precedent for a ruled main-red stanch claim writes the exception into the text: `lanes/ui.md:9` 「维护者裁决例外于上条与 SKILL.md 无标签禁认领:main/队列 `Spec Main Shape Gate` 红即止血认领」. The gap is one clause on SKILL.md, where the 红线 lives: name the main-red anchor as a fourth channel on `SKILL.md:175`, or as the exception on 红线 `:34`. Payable in place, measured: `:175` is 117 bytes on the head and 「- 越界只四通道:跨域例外路径、认领席跟到底的越界面、接手无主阻塞项、main-red 锚卡。」 is 117 bytes; `:34` is 114 bytes and every 「除外」 form measured lands at 122–139 bytes, so `:175` is the cheaper carrier. SKILL.md stays at 319, no re-wrap. Without that clause the new rule is the losing side of SKILL.md's own 优先序 in exactly the case that motivated the card.

**(c) Surviving lines read against the new rule** (the whole skill on `origin/main` grepped for 分诊首触, 无分诊审计, 锚卡, main-red, 止血, 在飞, 不动, 例外一):
- `SKILL.md:34`, `cross-repo-coordination.md:38` and `:42` — contradict, see (b).
- `triage-duties.md:74` (head 75) 「车道席…⛔ 不定级不改标…车道 ⛔ 不自分诊」 — the seat now files with `priority:p0` and a `domain:*`; covered by the head's `SKILL.md:171` 「两例外豁免」 and by `:25` of the same file, so a reader of either file meets the exception. Residual only; the patch round may touch it if bytes allow (117 on the head).
- `lanes/skills.md:22` 「本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊」 — about findings; an anchor is a class ① defect card. No conflict.
- `lanes/ui.md:9`, `reading-discipline.md:25` 「任何车道发现都立即止血并立单,见 landing-operations B」, `contract-review.md:41` 「主干红止血立单不变」, `execution-duties.md:42` 「分诊首触定域可改判」 — consistent; `reading-discipline.md:25` already pointed at §B for exactly this and §B now says it.
- `cross-repo-coordination.md:46` 「`pm:retriage` 改路由只对未派发卡」 against 「可改域」 on an in-flight anchor — no conflict: the claim stays to MERGED (`:45`), the domain change is a label correction, and the triage side carves it at `triage-duties.md:25` and `:71`.
- `AGENTS.md:534–535` 「triage files it under the main-red convention」 — contradicted by design: Tier H prose excluded by the card, and AGENTS.md wins over `.claude/skills/**` by its own header until the maintainer edits it. Said, not failed on. The fourth existing convention (no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile) lives on that AGENTS.md line and was never in `landing-operations.md`, as the PR body says.
- 「仅限 main-red 修复」 — position-carried, see (a). Nothing else in the grep set conflicts.

**Ratchet and lint — read on the head tree, verdict from the check-runs.** Line counts on `46774c37`: SKILL.md 319, landing-operations.md 101, execution-duties.md 188, triage-duties.md 103 = the CEILINGS rows on `origin/main` (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:403`, `:1207`, `:1340`, `:1301`). Every rewritten or added line measured in bytes: SKILL.md 170/171 = 118/118; execution-duties 10/40 = 114/116; landing-operations 80–84 = 118/109/92/116/110; triage-duties 25/71 = 109/116; MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120 (`:2472`). No re-wrap: every hunk is an in-place rewrite or a whole-line retire-and-add. id-lint: no `#` followed by three or more digits in the four head files; no control bytes in the added lines. Check-runs on `46774c37` read at 2026-10-26T15:48Z: 44 runs, 26 success, 18 skipped, none in progress, none failed — among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Test Core`.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` only: nothing from any released package publishes, so `skip-changeset` is right and `Check Changeset` is green. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line start, matching the claim comment; the diff touches no accept set, no public surface and no metadata protocol. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR body Acceptance notes:
- Cross-lane claiming, 「named for the seat's review, not resolved here」 — resolved here as the FAIL in ①(b): the text needs the exception on SKILL.md, not only the ruling's rank behind it.
- The after-the-fact clause stated twice (landing-operations §B for the acting seat, triage-duties for the triage seat) — accepted: the two phase files have disjoint readers (`landing-operations.md:3`, `triage-duties.md:3`) and the second copy was paid by a true 红线 duplicate.
- Carrier: AGENTS.md 「triage files it」 to the maintainer — accepted; Tier H, by design, see ①(c).

os-dev-report `deviations`: SKILL.md 170–171 touched in place — accepted (necessary, line-neutral; the card allowed a paid SKILL.md line). triage-duties.md touched — accepted (the card said only if a word is needed; old lines 70 and 74 would otherwise bar the ordered first touch; paid by old 78). Derived sweep restarted on the merged head, branch pushed with the first commit, install timing, commits authored as os-warren with the model-free trailer pair — process notes, nothing for this review to answer. Cross-lane tension — ①(b). `rules_retired` — each answered in ①(a). `out_of_scope_findings` — the AGENTS.md carrier, acknowledged. `open_questions` — none.

PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` confirmed from the PR object; no off-relay login to name.

## Contract review
Reviewed at 2026-10-26T16:04Z

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a289a0552b48ec886522fd6d6d03de61b620041c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, AGENTS.md

Inputs: card #26143 body and its four comments (triage first grade 6417894401, claim 6419390894, os-dev-report 6420148592, patch-round os-dev-report 6420603205); PR #26210 object (body byte-unchanged since the first record), file list and net diff against `main` (4 files, +11 / -11); the patch commit `a289a055`, one commit on top of `46774c37` (parent confirmed), one in-place line; the check-runs on `a289a055`; the rules text on `origin/main` at `43b47156` (still no commit since merge-base `7111e14a` touching `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` or `AGENTS.md`); the head tree by `git show a289a055:PATH`. Prior record on `46774c37`: comment 6420514256, FAIL on ①(b). This record re-judges ①(b) and re-affirms the rest only where the new head changes it. PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (type Bot), relay-written.

### ① Derived judgments

**The patch.** `SKILL.md:175` 「跨域相交只经三条越界通道:跨域例外路径、认领席跟到底的越界面、接手无主阻塞项。」 → 「越界只四通道:跨域例外路径、认领席跟到底的越界面、接手无主阻塞项、main-red 锚卡。」, in place, 117 → 117 bytes. Nothing else in the tree moved: `landing-operations.md`, `execution-duties.md` and `triage-duties.md` are byte-identical to `46774c37`, and SKILL.md's net diff against `origin/main` is lines 170, 171 and 175.

**(b) closed.** The main-red anchor is now an entry of the closed channel list (「只」 kept) that already licensed the three cross-domain channels beside 红线 `SKILL.md:34` 「执行席只在本车道认领」 on `origin/main`. The 红线 is untouched (114 bytes) and reads exactly as it did before the PR — in-lane only, except through the channels SKILL.md names — with the anchor claim now one of them; a seat that sees a red in another lane's surface files the anchor under `SKILL.md:170`, claims it under `:175` and dispatches under `landing-operations.md:81`, and stops nowhere. The channel's substance (who files, with what domain, which stanch, what triage does after) stays at `landing-operations.md:80–83`, the same way the other three entries carry theirs at `SKILL.md:172`, `cross-repo-coordination.md:45` and `execution-duties.md:45` with `dispatch-runbook.md:176`. The wording drops the subject 「跨域相交」 for 「越界」; the three existing names are verbatim; nothing is lost. This is the clause the first record specified, byte for byte. No surviving line restates the channel count: the whole skill on `origin/main` grepped for 越界 finds line 175 only, and the other 三条 hits (`SKILL.md:206`, `execution-duties.md:172` and `:188`, `landing-operations.md:18` and `:67`, `triage-duties.md:92`, lane and platform-readings lines) are 三条件 or 三条判据 lines unrelated to channels; `dispatch-runbook.md:173–178` 「在飞卡衍生与阻塞项三类细则」 enumerates three kinds of derived and blocker items, not the channel list. `cross-repo-coordination.md:38` 「执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领」 and `:42` 「代扫…不跨车道认领」 restate the 红线 without enumerating channels: they coexisted with three channels and coexist with four by the same reading, and `:42` is the triage-substitute case, which never reached a stanch claim. No contradiction is left that the text cannot resolve.

**(c) revised only here.** `triage-duties.md:75` 「车道席可附证据/前提重验,⛔ 不定级不改标;每张卡欠一次分诊首触,车道 ⛔ 不自分诊」 is left as is: it stands at 117 bytes on the head and the dev measured every in-place form carrying the exception at 124 and 128 bytes, over MAX_LINE_BYTES 120. Acceptable as left, as the first record already read it: the head's `SKILL.md:171` 「两例外豁免」 exempts the anchor from 队列与级别只由分诊落笔, `:25` of the same file has the seat file and dispatch first with the first touch owed after, and filing a new card with its labels is not 改标 on an existing one; a reader of either file meets the exception before acting. A later compression round may fold it in; not a lost rule and not a contradiction a seat would act on.

**(a) re-affirmed, unchanged.** The patch retires no line and touches none of the homes the first record opened; old line 175 is rewritten, not retired, and keeps 只 and all three names. The rest of (a), (c) and the rules-added findings stand as written in comment 6420514256, including the AGENTS.md 「triage files it」 sentence: contradicted by design, Tier H, said and not failed on.

**Ratchet and lint, read on the head tree.** Line counts on `a289a055`: SKILL.md 319, landing-operations.md 101, execution-duties.md 188, triage-duties.md 103 = the CEILINGS rows (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:403`, `:1207`, `:1340`, `:1301`); line 175 = 117 bytes, under MAX_LINE_BYTES 120 (`:2472`); no re-wrap, no ceiling moved; id-lint: no `#` followed by three or more digits in SKILL.md; no control bytes in the new line. Check-runs on `a289a055` read at 2026-10-26T16:03Z: 39 runs, 25 success, 14 skipped, none in progress, none failed — among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Test Core`; `Check Changeset` skipped, the `skip-changeset` label's expected path.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged by the patch: `.claude/**` only, nothing from any released package publishes, `skip-changeset` is right; the PR body is byte-unchanged and carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line start, matching the claim comment; no accept set, public surface or metadata protocol is touched. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

Patch-round os-dev-report 6420603205, each flag:
- PR body not patched (os-dev.md writes the body once, ⛔ no PATCH) — accepted. The body's 「SKILL.md lines 170–171, edited in place」 paragraph and its Acceptance-notes sentence that rode the claim on 接手无主阻塞项 are now stale and are superseded by the dev's clause, quoted here so the record carries it: 「SKILL.md line 175, in place: the closed list of cross-lane channels gains the main-red anchor as its fourth entry (越界只四通道:…、main-red 锚卡), so the seeing seat's claim of an anchor in another lane's domain rides a named channel; 红线 line 34 untouched.」 The seat folds it into the final 速读 when it corrects the draft against the diff it read (`SKILL.md:194`). The Rules-retired list is unaffected.
- `triage-duties.md:75` skipped — answered in ①(c).
- Derived sweep narrowed to the ratchet family on the patch head, declared — the check-runs on `a289a055` are the verdict; the four local readings the report quotes match the head-tree readings above.
- Base not merged (`origin/main` moved 6b935529 → 43b47156 since the first head; ff-only refused) — no governed-path commit since merge-base `7111e14a`; the PR reads `mergeable: true`, state `blocked` (draft, governed); the base is the landing window's business under landing-operations §B, not a contract item.
- Worktree recreated; commit authored as os-warren with the model-free trailer pair — process notes.
- `open_questions` none; `out_of_scope_findings` none this round; the first round's AGENTS.md carrier stands.

PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` confirmed from the PR object; no off-relay login to name.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-26T16:05Z

Seat review of record for #26143 on head `a289a055`, against GitHub, not the report's own account. Governed `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` PR, Tier S: the record that unlocks landing is the independent `## Contract review` at comment 6420788844 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `a289a055`, `VERDICT: PASS`, drafted by a reviewer other than the implementer), after a first round on `46774c37` (6420514256, FAIL on one point, patched in one in-place line). This seat adds the landing read, not a second contract read.
